name: ghost-replica
displayName: GhostReplica: Slow Folder Retyper & Input Simulator
description: Authentic physical OS-level mouse movement and keystroke simulation engine for recreating codebases

ghostReplica.defaultMinTypeDelayMs.description: Default minimum delay between keystrokes in milliseconds

ghostReplica.defaultMaxTypeDelayMs.description: Default maximum delay between keystrokes in milliseconds

ghostReplica.defaultMouseSpeedMs.description: Default mouse traversal duration in milliseconds

scripts.build:engine: dotnet publish engine_src/automation_engine.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o bin
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:engine
